problem_text:
A logistics firm must allocate a fleet of specialized vehicles from maintenance depots to regional distribution hubs in order to minimize total dispatch expenses.

The number of available vehicles at each depot (set D) is as follows:
* Depot D1 has 69 vehicles ready.
* Depot D2 has 73 vehicles ready.
* Depot D3 has 153 vehicles ready.
* Depot D4 has 181 vehicles ready.
* Depot D5 has 121 vehicles ready.
* Depot D6 has 144 vehicles ready.
* Depot D7 has 166 vehicles ready.
* Depot D8 has 174 vehicles ready.
* Depot D9 has 133 vehicles ready.

The required vehicle count at each distribution hub (set H) is specified below:
* Hub H1 requires 138 vehicles.
* Hub H2 requires 135 vehicles.
* Hub H3 requires 15 vehicles.
* Hub H4 requires 154 vehicles.
* Hub H5 requires 101 vehicles.
* Hub H6 requires 110 vehicles.
* Hub H7 requires 134 vehicles.
* Hub H8 requires 126 vehicles.
* Hub H9 requires 62 vehicles.

The cost per vehicle dispatched from a given depot to a specific hub is detailed in the following table:
| From / To | H1 | H2 | H3 | H4 | H5 | H6 | H7 | H8 | H9 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| D1 | 14 | 7 | 16 | 9 | 11 | 10 | 11 | 18 | 19 |
| D2 | 5 | 19 | 16 | 11 | 2 | 2 | 4 | 15 | 1 |
| D3 | 4 | 6 | 15 | 15 | 1 | 14 | 7 | 5 | 10 |
| D4 | 6 | 9 | 3 | 12 | 9 | 3 | 12 | 6 | 2 |
| D5 | 13 | 10 | 8 | 14 | 3 | 4 | 1 | 7 | 16 |
| D6 | 3 | 5 | 19 | 8 | 17 | 15 | 1 | 1 | 11 |
| D7 | 4 | 14 | 5 | 16 | 3 | 8 | 13 | 3 | 4 |
| D8 | 4 | 11 | 12 | 10 | 5 | 13 | 5 | 5 | 3 |
| D9 | 17 | 19 | 1 | 20 | 6 | 15 | 12 | 7 | 5 |

Determine the optimal allocation of vehicles from depots to hubs to minimize the aggregate dispatch cost.
